summary: Tested 4 additive enhancements (countdown timer, fest schedule/dress code/trophy note on Contact, embedded Google Map, category icons on EventCards) across Home, Events, Contact pages at desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (375x844) viewports. All features render correctly with proper waits (2-3s) for fade-in animations to complete; the main agent's earlier screenshot-timing artifact was NOT reproducible - all elements fully visible with opacity:1 confirmed via computed style. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: CountdownTimer.tsx, CategoryIcon.tsx, FestSchedule.tsx are small, clean, well-scoped components - no issues found.

Countdown days value showed 59 (not the 200-260 range mentioned in the request) - this is NOT a bug; it's because the actual sandbox system clock is Aug 11 2026, not Feb 2026 as stated in the problem context. Math is correct: Aug 11 2026 -> Oct 10 2026 = ~59 days. No code change needed.
site.ts schedule object content (dress code 3 bullets, trophy note, competitions/closing notes) matches exactly what was expected - no invented details.

Minor pre-existing (out-of-scope) observation: on mobile viewport (375px), the 'SHISFEST'26' logo text in the top nav bar is partially overlapped/cut off by the 'REGISTER NOW' button. This appears to be a pre-existing nav bar layout issue unrelated to this session's additive changes (nav bar not touched in file list), flagging for awareness only, not a regression from this session.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 additive enhancements verified end-to-end: (1) Countdown timer on Home hero renders correctly with data-testid hero-countdown/countdown-days/countdown-hours/countdown-minutes, values plausible and stable after reload, no NaN. (2) 26 EventCards across all categories on /events + 3 preview cards on Home all show correct distinct lucide icons inside .event-card-tag, no missing icons, category filter (tested Science filter) and modal open/close both work with no regression. (3) Contact page shows fest-schedule with 3 timeline steps (Reporting Time/Competitions/Closing Ceremony), dress-code-callout with exactly 3 bullets matching spec, trophy-note with correct Overall Winner Trophy + Scottish High ineligibility text. (4) venue-map-embed iframe loads google.com/maps src with correct venue address, sized 220px tall x full container width on both desktop and mobile, no overflow. Mobile viewport (375px) tested on all 3 pages - zero horizontal overflow (scrollWidth==clientWidth==375 on all pages), all new sections stack cleanly. No console errors/exceptions on any page (only harmless React DevTools info log). Minor unrelated nav-bar logo/button overlap on mobile noted for awareness only.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found. The main agent's reported screenshot-timing artifact was investigated by waiting 2500-3000ms after navigation before taking screenshots/reading DOM, and confirming computed opacity:1 on the countdown element - all elements render fully visible, confirming it was purely a screenshot-tool timing artifact, not a real rendering bug.
